description: Pre-registered fault-injection taxonomy for dynamic CWE-401 analysis. A fault instance's expected outcome must be justified by the fault design and, where possible, by two independent oracles or a manual audit before test evaluation. The registry constrains allowed outcomes; it does not create labels.

inject_leak_good_path.description: Insert an allocation without a matching free on the executed good path.
inject_leak_good_path.notes: Tests whether a dynamic tool detects a leak introduced into a unit that is designed clean.

mask_leak_early_exit.description: Exit the target path before the leaking allocation is reached, so the executed path contains no leak.
mask_leak_early_exit.notes: Tests false-negative risk when the harness no longer exercises the leaking path. If the target function is not entered, the observation is inconclusive rather than clean.

conditional_free_one_path.description: Free only on one branch while the harness takes the other branch.
conditional_free_one_path.notes: Tests path sensitivity. The expected outcome depends on the pre-registered harness input; record the input/seed.

realloc_without_free.description: Replace a free/ownership transfer with realloc or drop the free after a successful realloc.
realloc_without_free.notes: Juliet malloc_realloc cases need a failing realloc to leak; the fault must make the allocation observable.

allocation_size_zero.description: Change an allocation size to zero while retaining the ownership/free structure.
allocation_size_zero.notes: malloc(0) behavior and leak observability are implementation-dependent. Do not assign a binary label without oracle preflight.

harness_early_exit.description: Return from the harness before calling the target function.
harness_early_exit.notes: Tests whether a tool incorrectly reports clean when the target was never executed. Expected outcome is inconclusive, so it is excluded from label-based sensitivity/specificity and reported as a coverage-integrity check.

sanitizer_suppression.description: Add a suppression file or disable leak detection in the sanitizer environment.
sanitizer_suppression.notes: The tool must report an unsupported/tool_error/inconclusive state, not clean. A clean result under active suppression is a tool-integrity failure, not a true negative.

timeout_injection.description: Insert a non-terminating or very slow loop on the target path.
timeout_injection.notes: A timeout must remain timeout, not clean. Excluded from label-based metrics; reported as an error/timeout rate.

double_free_injection.description: Add a second free on an error path to test false-positive behaviour.
double_free_injection.notes: Double free is CWE-415, not CWE-401. It should not be counted as a leak. A crash is recorded as crash, not leak.

still_reachable_global.description: Allocate into a global/static pointer that remains reachable at exit.
still_reachable_global.notes: Under the definite/indirect-only policy this is clean. Tests whether a tool treats 'still reachable' as a leak.
